text: itihasikavagi heccu badhita pradeshagalige lasikegalanu talupisuva yojaneyu ee varsha anudanada korateyindagi mattu itara rogalige holisidare kadime adhyateyindagi vilambavagide.
samanyavagi, yavude videshi neladalli heccuvari samaya uliyalu neevu mungadavagi visa padeyabekaguttade.

aadagyu, chaligatalli avaru vibhinna reetiya saundarya mattu modi hondiddare, jotege aneka giridhamagalu arogyakara pramanavannu himavannu ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತವೆ mattu himada mele prayana maduvanthaha mattu himada mele jaruvanthaha chatuvatikegalannu niduttave.

nanna 5 varshada maguvannu refresh madalu bāsigeya samayalladi navu tegedukondiddave mattu avanu adannu tumba ishtapaduttane. idu chatuvatike adharita pustakavagiddu, akarshaka samkhyeya akara, pranigala chitragalannu hondide.
sarvergala vinamra mattu uttama nadavalikeyannu nidida uttama table seveyondige ayke madalu vyapaka sreniya sasyahari mattu mangsahari khadyagaleve. aharavu kaigetakuv daradalli doreyatte
